name: paperclipImportCompany
description: Apply a company import (legacy route). Accepts either the inline JSON body (`application/json`) or the raw company package uploaded as a compressed zip (`multipart/form-data` with a `package` file field plus a JSON `meta` field, or a bare `application/zip` body with the `meta` JSON in the `meta` query parameter); the zip is unzipped server-side into the same import bundle. Callers can opt into asynchronous processing: trusted Cloud tenants set the `x-paperclip-cloud-async-import: 1` header (browsers cannot — the Cloud harness proxy strips inbound `x-paperclip-cloud-*` headers), while board sessions use the proxy-safe `?async=1` query parameter. Either way the server responds 202 with a job id and status URL instead of holding the connection open for the whole import. While a board actor already has an async job running, a resubmit returns 409 carrying the running job's id and status URL. Jobs are held in memory and are lost on restart.

name: paperclipSetAiConnectionDefault
description: Set the signed-in owner’s personal AI default

name: paperclipSetChatEndpointConfiguration
description: Save GitHub bot review configuration. Compares the configuration revision and rechecks members, sponsors, repositories, and agent tool governance. Does not change the bot's assigned agent or enable formal reviews implicitly.

name: paperclipSetChatEndpointGithubProgress
description: Save GitHub setup progress. Saves the resumable wizard stage without granting access or bypassing verification.

name: paperclipSetChatEndpointResource
description: Replace chat endpoint destination access. Enables or disables known provider destinations. Every resource must belong to the endpoint, and an unavailable or removed provider destination cannot be enabled.

name: paperclipSetDecisionTriage
description: Set decision triage for an attention source

name: paperclipSetIssueModelOverride
description: Set or clear the per-task adapter model and thinking override

name: paperclipSetIssueWatchdog
description: Schedule or clear the issue monitor. Use only when you really want the assignee woken later; never claim a watcher without writing one.

name: paperclipSetProjectRepository
description: Replace selected GitHub source repositories. Saves provider IDs transactionally, refreshes canonical names and URLs, and preserves legacy workspace URLs. Unavailable existing selections can remain; new selections must be available to the caller.

name: paperclipSetResourceMembershipMeAgent
description: Join or leave an agent resource

name: paperclipSetResourceMembershipMeDocument
description: Star or unstar a document resource

name: paperclipSetResourceMembershipMeProject
description: Join or leave a project resource

name: paperclipSetSidebarPreferences
description: Replace the caller's sidebar ordering preferences.

name: paperclipSetSlackEndpointSearch
description: Configure optional Slack search OAuth credentials. Experimental Slack task tools. Current company, endpoint, linked requester, task/run authority and action permissions are revalidated. Bot credentials remain server-side. Search grants never authorize writes or expand bot membership. Native search is unavailable until the runtime qualifies transient result handling.

name: paperclipSetStatusCardQuery
description: Write a compiled status card query

name: paperclipSetStatusCardSummary
description: Write a generated status card summary

name: paperclipSetSummarySlot
description: Write a summary revision (Summarizer built-in agent only)

name: paperclipSetToolConnectionGrantMember
description: Replace the member audience of a tool connection grant

name: paperclipSetupChatEndpoint
description: Configure or change chat endpoint lifecycle state. Runs a setup or lifecycle action. `configure` and `reconnect` accept provider credentials (Slack: `botToken`, `signingSecret`; GitHub: `appId`, `privateKey` after Paperclip generates the webhook secret; Discord: `applicationId`, `guildId`, `botToken`; Microsoft Teams: `clientId`, `tenantId`, `clientSecret`; Telegram: `botToken`; iMessage Photon: `projectSecret`, with nonsecret `photon.projectId` and `photon.lineId` configuration). Credentials are stored as Paperclip secret references and are never returned. Other actions do not require credentials.

name: paperclipSetUserInboxAgentPolicy
description: Update a company user's inbox agent policy

name: paperclipSetUserMeInboxAgentPolicy
description: Update the current user's inbox agent policy

name: paperclipSkipIssueInteraction
description: Skip a pending issue thread interaction

name: paperclipSmokeToolExample
description: Run tool example governance smoke checks

name: paperclipSshToolConnectionRailway
description: Prepare, enable, or remove a Railway container SSH key

name: paperclipStartAgentMeConnection
description: Start user authorization for an agent tool connection

name: paperclipStartToolConnection
description: Start user authorization for a tool connection

name: paperclipSteerIssueQueuedComment
description: Steer a queued issue comment into the active native run

name: paperclipStopToolRuntimeSlot
description: Stop a local stdio MCP runtime slot

name: paperclipSuggestTransitionCase
description: Suggest transition for a pipeline case.

name: paperclipSyncAgentSkill
description: Sync desired skills onto an agent configuration

name: paperclipTaskDrainInstance
description: Start a task drain, so new run admission holds until active runs finish

name: paperclipTestChatEndpoint
description: Complete a chat endpoint setup test. Activates a verifying endpoint only after Paperclip has received a real provider event since the server-issued setup test boundary. iMessage Photon additionally requires a fresh linked sender's task and a successful outbound agent publication.

name: paperclipTestEnvironmentAdapter
description: Validate adapter environment access for a company

name: paperclipTrustRuleToolActionRequest
description: Create a tool trust rule from an action request

name: paperclipUnarchiveInstanceLifecycle
description: Unarchive the Cloud-pinned primary company (idempotent); used by the Cloud control plane while restoring an archived stack

name: paperclipUnbindToolProfile
description: Unbind a tool access profile from a company, agent, project, routine, or issue

name: paperclipUpdateAdapterOverride
description: Pause or resume an adapter's override of a builtin

name: paperclipUpdateChatEndpoint
description: Update chat endpoint access behavior. Updates the small set of user-configurable access toggles. Provider identity, assigned agent, delivery mode, and maximal provider capabilities are not mutable here.

name: paperclipUpdateDecisionRetention
description: Set Keep for an attention source

name: paperclipUpdateGoal
description: Update a goal's title, description, status, or target date.

name: paperclipUpdateMember
description: Update a company member status or role

name: paperclipUpdateMemberRoleAndGrant
description: Update a company member role and explicit grants

name: paperclipUpdatePipelineStageEnv
description: Update a pipeline stage automation env.

name: paperclipUpdateProject
description: Update a project's name, description, or settings.

name: paperclipUpdateRoutineAnnotation
description: Update a routine description annotation thread

name: paperclipUpdateStatusCard
description: Update, archive, or restore a status card

name: paperclipUpdateToolProfileEntry
description: Update a tool access profile entry

name: paperclipUpdateWorkProduct
description: Update a recorded work product, for example when a pull request merges.

name: paperclipVerifyChatEndpointGithub
description: Verify GitHub bot and assigned-agent capabilities. Separately checks signed delivery, App identity, current repository permissions, effective tool access, and runtime support. Requires connection-management access.

name: paperclipWakeupAgent
description: Wake up an agent. Board failed-run retries supply failedRunId with reason retry_failed_run. Paperclip derives the exact request and current authorization; a chat retry may return a durable queued/deferred receipt before a run exists. Caller task/comment markers and fresh-session overrides do not authorize replay.

name: paperclipWithdrawIssueInteraction
description: Withdraw a pending issue-thread interaction you raised and no longer need answered.
